transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm having some trouble at work. I'm a barber, and... well, I've gotten to the point where I'll do almost anything to avoid using a straight razor. 

I'll, uh, switch clients with someone else, or... just tell them the blade's missing. I even hide it in my drawer sometimes. And if I really can't get out of it... I just end up shaking through the whole shave. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Is it just the straight razor that you're trying to avoid, or are there other tasks or tools at work that you've been avoiding as well?

No, just... just the straight razor. I can use the clippers and the shears all day without a problem. It's just... I know it's a tool I trained with, but... when it's sitting there open at my station, I just... I get this feeling like I'm going to hurt somebody. Or... or cut myself really badly. So, yeah. Just that.
Is the fear you experience related to the actual act of cutting someone with the straight razor, or is it more about having the razor in your hand or seeing it?

Um... I guess it's just seeing it. Or even... just hearing them ask for it. 

Like, the second a client asks for a razor shave, or if I just see the blade flipped open... my chest gets tight. My hands get sweaty. It's just... my body wants to back away before I even really think about anything else. So... yeah.
Do you experience a similar feeling of fear or anxiety when you're around other sharp objects, like knives or scissors, outside of work?
No, not really. Just the razor. Knives and stuff are... they're fine. I cook at home a lot, and it doesn't bother me. It's just... just the straight razor.
Do you experience this fear or anxiety when you see a straight razor outside of a barber setting, like at home or in a store?
I don't know... I don't really see them anywhere else. I mean, they're not exactly sitting around at the grocery store. So... I'm not sure.
Would you feel anxious or fearful if you were to hold or see a straight razor in a non-barber setting, such as at home, for a purpose unrelated to shaving someone?
I don't really know. I wouldn't... I don't keep them at my house. There's no reason for me to have one there. So... I couldn't tell you.
Would you feel anxious if you were to hold a straight razor at home, just for a moment, with no intention of shaving anyone?
I... I don't know. I've never tried. I just... I avoid them completely if I don't have to use one for work. So, I really couldn't say.
Would you feel anxious if you were to hold a straight razor at home, with no intention of shaving anyone, just to clean or store it?
I... I really don't know. Like I said, I don't have them at home. I just... I don't put myself in that situation.
Would you feel anxious if you were to hold a straight razor at home for a purpose completely unrelated to shaving, such as using it as a prop for a hobby?
I... I don't have any hobbies like that. Look, I just... I don't bring them into my house for any reason. I really don't know what else to tell you.
Would you feel anxious if you were to see a straight razor being used by someone else in a non-barber setting, such as in a movie or a play?
I don't really watch things like that. If something like that comes on the screen, I just... I look away. So I couldn't really tell you.
Would you feel anxious if you were to see someone else using a straight razor to shave another person?
I... I don't watch other people do that. If one of the other guys at the shop is doing a shave, I just... find a reason to go to the back room. I don't stick around to see how I'd feel.
Would you feel anxious if you were to see someone else using a straight razor for a purpose other than shaving, such as cutting a rope?
I... I don't really know. I just... I try to avoid them altogether, so I haven't been in a situation like that. I just stay away from them.
Would you feel anxious if you were to see someone else using a straight razor in a situation where they were not shaving anyone?
I... I think that's kind of what you just asked. I don't know. Like I said, I wouldn't be around to see it. If one is out, I just... I walk away.
Would you feel anxious if you were to see someone else using a straight razor in a medical setting, such as a doctor using it for a surgical procedure?

I... I don't really know why a doctor would be using one of those. I've never seen that. But... I mean, I wouldn't be looking. Like I keep saying, I just... I don't want to be anywhere near them, no matter who is holding it.
Would you feel anxious if you were to see a straight razor being used by a surgeon in an operating room?

I... I feel like you keep asking me the same thing. I really don't know. 

I wouldn't be awake in an operating room anyway. But... if I was, like I just said, I wouldn't look at it. I don't have a different answer for you. I just want to stay away from them.
Would you feel anxious if you were to see a straight razor being used in a completely safe and controlled environment, like a museum exhibit?

I... look, a museum? I don't... I don't know. I wouldn't go to an exhibit like that in the first place. 

It doesn't really matter if it's behind glass or... or safe, or whatever. If it's there, I'm not. That's... that's all I can tell you.
Would you feel anxious if you were to see a straight razor that was rusty, old, and clearly unusable?

I... I don't know. Rusty or not, it's still... what it is. 

It doesn't make a difference to me. I just wouldn't be around it. I don't really get why we keep going over this.
Would you feel anxious if you were to see a straight razor being used by someone else for a purpose that has nothing to do with shaving?

I... I don't think it matters what they're using it for. 

If someone has one, I'm... I'm just going to leave. I don't want to see it. I don't want to think about it. I just... I really don't want to talk about these things anymore.
Would you feel anxious if you were to hold a straight razor with the intention of giving yourself a shave?
I... I don't shave with one. I just... I wouldn't do that. I can't even think about holding one right now. Can we please just move on?
Would you feel anxious if you were to hold a straight razor with no blade in it?
I... I don't know. It's the shape of it, the... just what it is. Empty or not, I wouldn't touch it. I just... I can't do this anymore. Please.
